name: SDK → concurrent native tools → approved edit → final answer; replay only rebuilds context
expectedState: 并发工具之后的写入必须经批准；重放只重建上下文。

name: native model batches execute concurrently with bounded scheduling and atomic reservations
expectedState: 同批 Native 工具受有界并发与原子用量预留约束。

name: approved replies are single-use and consumption checks current arguments, workspace, and generation
expectedState: 审批凭据只能消费一次，参数、工作区和代际必须匹配。

name: policy changes, replacement calls, and expiry revoke pending and already-approved requests
expectedState: 策略改变、替换调用和过期撤销待决及已批准请求。

name: recovery distinguishes complete, not-started, and uncertain calls without executing anything
expectedState: 恢复区分已完成、未开始和不确定调用，恢复本身不执行工具。

name: external success plus local result-commit failure remains uncertain and is never retried
expectedState: 外部成功而本地结果提交失败时保留不确定态，不自动重试。

name: compression preserves constraints, protected information, task state, and the original journal
expectedState: 压缩保留约束、受保护信息、任务状态及原始日志。

name: more than twenty model requests and one million tokens do not stop a run
expectedState: 累计请求数和 token 消耗只计量，不因旧累计额度终止任务。

name: pending approvals can be cancelled; a late allow cannot dispatch the write
expectedState: 已取消审批收到迟到允许回复也不得执行写入。

name: L1 validates schemas and changes only subsequent run snapshots without draining
expectedState: L1 先校验配置，已存在 run 保留其快照。

name: L2 stages registrations before blocking, acquires after drain, and pairs schema with execute generation
expectedState: L2 在 drain 后切换，schema 与执行实现属于同一代际。

name: tools share a pinned caller view across services and handlers, with parent inheritance and sibling isolation
expectedState: 服务及工具处理器共享固定调用方目录视图，保留父继承与兄弟隔离。

name: native and PTC use scoped schemas and implementations; one Session can retain distinct same-name providers
expectedState: Native/PTC 使用相同 scoped schema 和实现绑定，同 Session 可保留同名不同 provider。

name: partial results survive program failure and the whole program is never automatically replayed
expectedState: PTC 部分结果在程序失败后保留，整段程序不自动重放。

name: automatic summary commits a smaller surface, retains constraints and accounts for the auxiliary request
expectedState: 自动摘要提交更小上下文，保留约束并计入辅助请求用量。

name: a successful PTC result cannot hide unconfirmed sandbox cleanup
expectedState: 程序成功不覆盖清理未确认，结果须保持 unknown。

name: workspace tools reject stale hashes, protected paths and symlinks
expectedState: 拒绝过期hash、受保护路径及符号链接写入。

name: tool execution cannot start until its fsync intent commit succeeds
expectedState: 意图提交失败时副作用次数为0。

name: Session and Context plugins survive Runtime restart, isolate sessions, and use unique run ids
expectedState: 跨重启保留上下文，各会话独立。

name: model/tool batches cannot be hidden until every child is settled, including unplanned children
expectedState: 任何子调用未结算时不得隐藏整个批次。

name: stale compaction candidates cannot replace a changed surface or omit new constraints
expectedState: 并发改变后拒绝过期摘要。

name: preflight rejects invalid graphs before any setup
expectedState: 无效依赖图在setup前拒绝。

name: cleanup failures are aggregated while all other resources still close
expectedState: 单个清理失败不阻止其他资源释放。

name: multiple mounts keep the same contract while provider caches, consumers and tool callbacks resolve by realm
expectedState: 同契约多实例解析正确且互不串用。

name: skill summaries, bodies and resources resolve one immutable nearest-layer definition
expectedState: Skill摘要正文与资源来自同一可见版本。

name: missing usage and unfinished calls stay unknown instead of zero consumption or successful completion
expectedState: 未知用量不伪造为0，未结束调用不报告成功。

name: shared sandbox cancellation closes PTC input admission immediately
expectedState: 取消后停止接收新PTC调用。

name: sandbox workspace copies binary/source files with readable modes and excludes credentials at every depth
expectedState: 副本不含凭据路径，原工作区不被改写。
